name: Barges
source:
Leica's contract spirit, in the form of a beast ("Belst"), although he has merely average power as a spirit, he is quick despite having a large body and has fighting capabilities that prove to be challenging even for more powerful opponents such as [url=/c39745]Corticarte Apa Lagranges[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://www.prot.co.jp/ps2/polyphonica2/index.html]PS2 edition's official website[/url].]
